scope: Released manufacturer evidence for a practical 40 A continuous / 45 A peak source connector and multi-connector alternatives.

single_connector_system.candidate: Samtec PET-08-02-T-VT-LC + PES-08-02-T-VT + configured PESS cable
single_connector_system.screen: 48.5 A/contact at two energized contacts after 20% derating and 30 C rise per TC0919-2456 Rev 2
single_connector_system.state: authority-review; exact configuration and local footprint bytes not retained

multiple_conventional_connectors.candidate: 3 x Molex 5569 six-circuit headers, e.g. 39-30-1060/1061, independent branches
multiple_conventional_connectors.screen: 3 x 3 positive contacts x 7 A/circuit = 63 A positive and equal return screen under PS-5556 Rev B1 4-6 circuit table
multiple_conventional_connectors.state: released-interface candidate; no-contact-sharing warning and branch protection required

fallback.screen: 6 x 8 A/circuit = 48 A aggregate under PS-5556 Rev B1 2-3 circuit table

footprint_authority.molex_5569: Manufacturer sales drawing 55690002-SD provides pitch, recommended hole layout, PCB thickness and circuit-size applicability; exact project-local footprint can be generated and audited from it.
footprint_authority.anderson_pp45: B02021S Rev 6 does not provide finished contact-tail drill/slot and pad/mask data in retained record; not fully closed as exact manufacturer land pattern.
footprint_authority.samtec_pet: Manufacturer page publishes print and footprint resources; exact configured bytes must be retrieved before CAD.

disposition: external:vendor-footprint-authorization is not irreducible for campaign; authority selection and thermal/branch closure remain open.
retention: metadata, URLs, revisions and extracted facts only; no vendor PDFs/CAD copied
